units: equivalent physical mm from approved keyboard scale
rationale: 3mm vertical is already visibly small relative to10mm key dip; 2mm horizontal is under10% of a23mm white key. Fixed before contact extraction, fitting, or result viewing.
root_model: fixed wrist-rest anatomical orientation; metre scale1; only XYZ translation
root_temporal_regularization: sum active assigned-pad target residuals squared + lambda*sum(second-difference translation squared); lambda=(0.080*60)^4; natural endpoints; no per-note tuning
root_y_target: white front+25mm; black front+15mm within actual playable region; fixed before fitting
contact_success_not_independent_validati: Fitted on predicted assignments; report fit residuals, not ground-truth evidence.
